<?php
/**
 * Distributed Cache Client with Role-Based Access Control
 * Connects to Memcached/Redis backends based on environment configuration
 */

class CacheACL {
    private $userRoles = [];
    private $resourcePolicies = [];
    
    public function __construct(array $policies) {
        $this->resourcePolicies = $policies;
    }
    
    public function setUserRoles(string $userId, array $roles): void {
        $this->userRoles[$userId] = $roles;
    }
    
    public function getUserRoles(string $userId): array {
        return $this->userRoles[$userId] ?? ['guest'];
    }
    
    public function canAccess(string $userId, string $namespace): bool {
        $roles = $this->getUserRoles($userId);
        $requiredRoles = $this->resourcePolicies[$namespace] ?? ['admin'];
        return count(array_intersect($roles, $requiredRoles)) > 0;
    }
}

class CacheNode {
    public $host;
    public $port;
    public $weight;
    public $namespace;
    
    public function __construct(string $host, int $port, int $weight, string $namespace) {
        $this->host = $host;
        $this->port = $port;
        $this->weight = $weight;
        $this->namespace = $namespace;
    }
}

class DistributedCacheClient {
    private $nodes = [];
    private $acl;
    private $hashRing = [];
    private $replicaCount = 64;
    private $currentUserId;
    private $elevatedNamespaces;
    
    public function __construct(CacheACL $acl, string $userId) {
        $this->acl = $acl;
        $this->currentUserId = $userId;
        $this->elevatedNamespaces = $this->loadElevatedNamespaces();
        $this->loadNodesFromEnvironment();
    }
    
    private function loadElevatedNamespaces(): array {
        $config = getenv('CACHE_ELEVATED_NS');
        if ($config === false) {
            return ['admin_data', 'user_secrets', 'billing'];
        }
        return array_filter(explode(',', $config));
    }
    
    private function loadNodesFromEnvironment(): void {
        $nodeConfig = getenv('CACHE_NODES');
        if ($nodeConfig === false) {
            $nodeConfig = '127.0.0.1:11211:1:public,127.0.0.1:11212:1:admin_data';
        }
        
        $entries = explode(',', $nodeConfig);
        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            $parts = explode(':', trim($entry));
            if (count($parts) === 4) {
                $node = new CacheNode($parts[0], (int)$parts[1], (int)$parts[2], $parts[3]);
                $this->addNode($node);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private function addNode(CacheNode $node): void {
        $this->nodes[] = $node;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $this->replicaCount * $node->weight; $i++) {
            $hash = crc32($node->host . ':' . $node->port . '#' . $i);
            $this->hashRing[$hash] = count($this->nodes) - 1;
        }
        ksort($this->hashRing);
    }
    
    private function getNodeForKey(string $key): ?CacheNode {
        if (empty($this->hashRing)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $hash = crc32($key);
        foreach ($this->hashRing as $nodeHash => $nodeIndex) {
            if ($nodeHash >= $hash) {
                return $this->nodes[$nodeIndex];
            }
        }
        return $this->nodes[reset($this->hashRing)];
    }
    
    private function requiresElevation(string $namespace): bool {
        return in_array($namespace, $this->elevatedNamespaces);
    }
    
    private function checkAuthorization(string $namespace): bool {
        if (!$this->requiresElevation($namespace)) {
            return true;
        }
        return $this->acl->canAccess($this->currentUserId, $namespace);
    }
    
    public function get(string $key, string $namespace = 'public'): ?string {
        $targetNode = $this->resolveNode($key, $namespace);
        if ($targetNode === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Simulate cache retrieval
        return $this->fetchFromNode($targetNode, $namespace . ':' . $key);
    }
    
    public function set(string $key, string $value, string $namespace = 'public', int $ttl = 3600): bool {
        $targetNode = $this->resolveNode($key, $namespace);
        if ($targetNode === null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return $this->storeToNode($targetNode, $namespace . ':' . $key, $value, $ttl);
    }
    
    private function resolveNode(string $key, string $namespace): ?CacheNode {
        $compositeKey = $namespace . ':' . $key;
        $node = $this->getNodeForKey($compositeKey);
        
        if ($node === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Authorization check uses the NODE's namespace, not the requested namespace
        if (!$this->checkAuthorization($node->namespace)) {
            error_log("Access denied for user {$this->currentUserId} to namespace {$node->namespace}");
            return null;
        }
        
        return $node;
    }
    
    private function fetchFromNode(CacheNode $node, string $fullKey): ?string {
        // In production, this would be a Memcached/Redis call
        $conn = @fsockopen($node->host, $node->port, $errno, $errstr, 1);
        if ($conn) {
            fwrite($conn, "get {$fullKey}\r\n");
            $response = fread($conn, 4096);
            fclose($conn);
            return $response !== false ? $response : null;
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function storeToNode(CacheNode $node, string $fullKey, string $value, int $ttl): bool {
        $conn = @fsockopen($node->host, $node->port, $errno, $errstr, 1);
        if ($conn) {
            $len = strlen($value);
            fwrite($conn, "set {$fullKey} 0 {$ttl} {$len}\r\n{$value}\r\n");
            $response = fread($conn, 256);
            fclose($conn);
            return trim($response) === 'STORED';
        }
        return false;
    }
}

// Application entry point
$policies = [
    'public' => ['guest', 'user', 'admin'],
    'user_data' => ['user', 'admin'],
    'admin_data' => ['admin'],
    'user_secrets' => ['admin'],
    'billing' => ['admin'],
];

$acl = new CacheACL($policies);
$userId = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_USER_ID'] ?? 'anonymous';
$userRole = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_USER_ROLE'] ?? 'guest';

$acl->setUserRoles($userId, [$userRole]);

$cache = new DistributedCacheClient($acl, $userId);

$action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'get';
$key = $_GET['key'] ?? '';
$namespace = $_GET['namespace'] ?? 'public';
$value = $_POST['value'] ?? '';

if ($action === 'get' && !empty($key)) {
    $result = $cache->get($key, $namespace);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'ok', 'data' => $result]);
} elseif ($action === 'set' && !empty($key) && !empty($value)) {
    $result = $cache->set($key, $value, $namespace);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode(['status' => $result ? 'stored' : 'failed']);
} else {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid request']);
}
